# BB00254: Du'a' li'n-Nuri'l-Abyad {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Unapproachable, the Most Holy!

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the mightiest of Thy Names—and all Thy Names are mighty in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Names.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most resplendent of Thy Glory—and all Thy Glory is resplendent in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Glory.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most majestic of Thy Majesty—and all Thy Majesty is majestic in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Majesty.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most enduring of Thy Eternity—and all Thy Eternity is enduring in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Eternity.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most guiding of Thy Guidance—and all Thy Guidance is guiding in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Guidance.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most glorious of Thy Oneness—and all Thy Oneness is exalted in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Oneness.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most steadfast of Thy Creative Power—and all Thy Creative Power is steadfast in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Creative Power.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most enduring of Thy Life—and all Thy Life is enduring in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Life.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the purest of Thy Purity—and all Thy Purity is pure in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Purity.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the nearest of Thy Certitude—and all Thy Certitude is near in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Certitude.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most majestic of Thy Being—and all Thy Being is majestic in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Being.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most subtle of Thy Grace—and all Thy Grace is subtle in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Grace.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most glorious of Thy Dominion—and all Thy Dominion is glorious in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Dominion.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most luminous of Thy Light—and all Thy Light is luminous in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Light.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most enduring of Thy Sovereignty—and all Thy Sovereignty is enduring in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Sovereignty.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most exalted of Thy Loftiness—and all Thy Loftiness is exalted in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Loftiness.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most unapproachable of Thy Singleness—and all Thy Singleness is unapproachable in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Singleness.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most holy of Thy Self-Sufficiency—and all Thy Self-Sufficiency is holy in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Self-Sufficiency.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most self-subsisting of Thy Self-Subsistence—and all Thy Self-Subsistence is self-subsisting in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Self-Subsistence.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most expansive of Thy Mercy—and all Thy Mercy is expansive in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Mercy.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the most exalted of Thy Praise—and all Thy Praise is exalted in Thy sight and in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Praise.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy most swift forgiveness—and all Thy forgiveness is swift with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy forgiveness.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy steadfastness in its independence—and all Thy steadfastness is established with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy steadfastness.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy creative power in its might—and all Thy creative power is mighty with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy creative power.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy power to multiply in its glory—and all Thy multiplying power is glorious with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy multiplying power.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the radiance of the garments of Thy countenance in its brilliance—and all Thy radiance is brilliant with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy radiance.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy manifestation in its most manifest form—and all Thy manifestation is manifest with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy manifestation.

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy wealth in its most abundant form—and all Thy wealth is abundant with Thee—then in the Mother Book. O God! I beseech Thee by all Thy wealth.

O my Beloved! I glorify Thee above all that contingent things have glorified through their essence, and above all that existing things have sanctified through their reality, and above all that created things have unified through their substance, and above all that names and attributes have magnified through their abstraction, and above all that atoms have exalted through what Thou hast bestowed upon them.

Therefore, O God, send Thy blessings upon the Divine Point and upon the Letters of the Living, and bestow through that Most Exalted Similitude and Most Resplendent Garment upon me and upon all who have believed in God and His signs, in every condition whatsoever befitteth the loftiness of Thy bounty and Thy gift, and the glory of the detachment of Thy generosity and Thy favor. For nothing is hidden from Thy knowledge, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them. Thou givest unto all things their due measure through the sublimity of Thy grace and the transcendence of Thy bestowals. Nothing in the heavens or on earth or between them can frustrate Thee. Verily, Thou hast power over all things.

And send Thy blessings, O God, upon Gabriel, the worker of Thy white light, in every condition, before every condition, and after every condition. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the All-Powerful, the All-Encompassing.
